panels.alt: MX Modular FX module with two rows of SELECT knob, preset display, SHIFT button and PARAM 1 to 3 knobs
panels.caption: Two independent FX engines, pre-routed to AUX 1 and AUX 2.

items.name: Preset select
items.label: SELECT
items.text: Turn to scroll through the presets; hold for 3 seconds to save, press briefly to confirm.

items.name: Preset display
items.text: Shows the preset number; it blinks while you choose a user bank slot to save to.

items.name: Shift
items.label: SHIFT
items.text: Switches the knobs between three parameter rows: unlit Row 1, lit Row 2, blinking Row 3.

ref.strong: Navigating Parameter Rows with the Shift Button

items.name: Parameter knobs
items.label: PARAM 1–3
items.text: Fine-tune the effect, such as time, feedback, mix and damping.
